# Ohio SHRM

> Ohio SHRM connects HR professionals across Ohio through local chapters, professional development, and advocacy initiatives.

Ohio SHRM is the state council affiliate of the Society for Human Resource Management (SHRM), serving HR professionals throughout Ohio with membership opportunities, certification resources, networking events, and workforce development programs. The organization operates multiple local chapters across major Ohio cities including Columbus, Cleveland, Akron, Toledo, and Dayton.

## Key Topics

- Local Chapters
- SHRM Membership
- Professional Development
- HR Certifications (SHRM-CP, SPHR)
- Networking Opportunities
- State Council Leadership
- Chapter Finder

- Diversity & Inclusion
- Government Affairs
- Workforce Readiness
- SHRM Foundation
- Conference Registration
- Ohio HR Professionals
- Chapter Designation

## Membership & Chapters

- [Membership](https://www.ohioshrm.org/membership/membership.cfm): Ohio SHRM membership information and local chapter directory
- [Chapter Finder](https://www.ohioshrm.org/chapters/chapter-finder.cfm): Find local Ohio SHRM chapters by region and location
- [Join a State Chapter](https://www.ohioshrm.org/membership/join-state-chapter.cfm): Join Ohio SHRM local chapters for networking and professional development
- [Join a Student Chapter](https://www.ohioshrm.org/membership/join-student-chapter.cfm): Join Ohio SHRM student chapters at universities across Ohio
- [Core Leadership Membership](https://www.ohioshrm.org/core-leadership/membership.cfm): Core leadership membership overview and professional development benefits

## Events & Conferences

- [HR Conference 2025](http://hrconference.ohioshrm.org): Ohio HR Conference 2025 registration, speakers, and volunteer opportunities
